api.update: update(gaitSeconds, speed, {action, progress, flowerTarget:[x,y], renderFlower:false, intent, impulse, hasFlower})
api.coordinates: Unmirrored local XY; Y is vertical; actual painted shoe sole y=0. Scene places the group in world XYZ and billboards around world Y.
api.state: getActionState() returns action, progress, phase, flowerOwnership, rootTravel, safeStops, nextSafeStop, contact, feet, hand, bag, flower.
api.flowerOwnership: pick stem->hand at .43, hand->bag at .86; reconsider bag->hand at .08, hand->bag at .94; place bag->hand at .20, hand->ground at .78; cross ground.
api.flowerContact: flowerTarget/getAttachment(flower) denotes stem grip, not plant root. Scene offsets its unique flower mesh to that grip and owns its planted root.
api.cross: Scene moves actor group by state.rootTravel along the new route. Complete release to nextSafeStop(progress): 0, .40, .67, 1. Feet subtract rootTravel in local X; new route should project approximately screen-right, or scene supplies event.feetTargets left/right local sole x/y/stance.
api.gait: Use getGaitMetrics(1,intent).travelPerGaitSecond to convert actual distance into gait seconds. Interpolate intent; do not accelerate the clock independently of travel.

limits: World flower mesh/grip offset and world depth occlusion must be verified in the composed scene.
No claim of frame-by-frame video inspection or audio review. Captured key poses and actual timed playback endpoint were inspected.
Independent critic must personally experience all three benchmark websites; this actor QA is not that critic.
